articles.text: DoorDash to let AI agents place real food orders. articles.text: ‘Just trying to get my bills paid’: Houston DoorDash driver hit by fleeing suspect finishes delivery. Miracle Herron was thrown onto a car mid-delivery and still dropped off the Subway order. Her story highlights the financial pressures and risks many gig workers face.
